ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms documented symbols, parameters and failure contracts are listed; it does not show the docstrings are accurate.
offer: Document the externally visible parameters and failure behavior of public symbols. A reader must be able to use the function without reconstructing its implementation.

minimal.reason: List the public symbols that carry docstrings. An empty list means callers must read the implementation, so name the documented functions and classes.

mid.reason: Document each public parameter's meaning and type. Missing parameter notes force callers to reverse-engineer inputs, so list them.

maximal.reason: Describe the failure behavior, such as raised errors or return codes. Without it a caller cannot handle failure, so state what each symbol does when it cannot succeed.
